starting-out-starting-the-quest.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
starting-out-starting-the-quest.text: I am the leader of the White Knights of Falador. Why do you seek my audience?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well, I need some spy work doing but it's quite dangerous. It will involve going into the Black Knights' fortress.

options.text: I laugh in the face of danger!

steps.player: I laugh in the face of danger!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well that's good. Don't get too overconfident though.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: You've come along at just the right time actually. All of my knights are already known to the Black Knights.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Subtlety isn't exactly our strong point.

steps.player: Can't you just take your White Knights' armour off? They wouldn't recognise you then!

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: I am afraid our charter prevents us using espionage in any form, that is the domain of the Temple Knights.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: That information is classified. I am forbidden to share it with outsiders.

steps.player: So... what do you need doing?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well, the Black Knights have started making strange threats to us; demanding large amounts of money and land, and threatening to invade Falador if we don't pay them.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Now, NORMALLY this wouldn't be a problem...

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: But they claim to have a powerful new secret weapon.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Your mission, should you decide to accept it, is to infiltrate their fortress, find out what their secret weapon is, and then sabotage it.

steps.prompt: Start the Black Knights' Fortress quest?

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Good luck! Let me know how you get on. Here's the dossier for the case, I've already given you the details.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Oh. You don't appear to have any room for the dossier in your inventory. Come back when you do.

steps.text: Come see me again if you change your mind.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Err....

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Well.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: I... suppose spy work DOES involve a little hiding in corners.

options.text: Oh. I suppose I'll give it a go then.

steps.player: Oh. I suppose I'll give it a go then.

I don't, I'm just looking around.

steps.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
steps.text: Ok. Please don't break anything.

starting-out-speaking-to-sir-amik-varze-.player: I haven't managed to find what the secret weapon is yet...

starting-out-speaking-to-sir-amik-varze-.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
starting-out-speaking-to-sir-amik-varze-.text: Well, keep at it! Falador's future is at stake!

steps.text: Here's the dossier on the case.

infiltrating-the-fortress-trying-to-open.speaker: Fortress Guard
infiltrating-the-fortress-trying-to-open.text: Hey! You can't come in here! This is a high security military installation!

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: Well, this is the guards' entrance. I might be new here but I can tell you're not a guard.

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: You're not even wearing proper guards uniform!

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: Go away. You're getting annoying.

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: Well you can see me wearing it. It's an iron chainbody and a medium bronze helm.

steps.player: Hmmm... I wonder if I can make that or get some in the local towns....

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: What was that you muttered?

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: Don't let it happen again.

options.text: So who does it belong to?

steps.player: So who does it belong to?

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: This fortress belongs to the order of Black Knights known as the Kinshra.

infiltrating-the-fortress-talking-to-the.speaker: Fortress Guard
infiltrating-the-fortress-talking-to-the.text: Get lost. This is private property.

infiltrating-the-fortress-talking-to-the.speaker: Fortress Guard
infiltrating-the-fortress-talking-to-the.text: Well, this is the guards' entrance. I might be new here but I can tell you're not a guard.

infiltrating-the-fortress-talking-to-the.speaker: Fortress Guard
infiltrating-the-fortress-talking-to-the.text: You're not even wearing proper guards uniform!

infiltrating-the-fortress-pushing-the-fa.text: You push against the wall. You find a secret passage.

listen-at-grill.speaker: Black Knight Captain
listen-at-grill.text: So... how's the secret weapon coming along?

listen-at-grill.speaker: Witch
listen-at-grill.text: The invincibility potion is almost ready...

listen-at-grill.speaker: Witch
listen-at-grill.text: It's taken me FIVE YEARS, but it's almost ready.

listen-at-grill.speaker: Witch
listen-at-grill.text: Greldo the Goblin here is just going to fetch the last ingredient for me.

listen-at-grill.speaker: Witch
listen-at-grill.text: It's a specially grown cabbage grown by my cousin Helda who lives in Draynor Manor.

listen-at-grill.speaker: Witch
listen-at-grill.text: The soil there is slightly magical and it gives the cabbages slight magical properties....

listen-at-grill.speaker: Witch
listen-at-grill.text: Now remember Greldo, only a Draynor Manor cabbage will do! Don't get lazy and bring any old cabbage, THAT would ENTIRELY wreck the potion!

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.player: I've found out what the Black Knight's secret weapon is. It's a potion of invincibility.

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.text: A potion of invincibility? That is grave news indeed. If you can sabotage it somehow, you will be very well paid.

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.player: So when I finish this mission for you can I be a white knight? Can I wear your armour too?

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.text: I am afraid I cannot authorise you to become a white knight unless under a situation of dire circumstance. Assisting us on a freelance basis will be well worth your time however and you will have my personal gratitude.

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.player: I can't buy stuff with personal gratitude though...

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.text: There is of course also the financial recompense as I said.

reporting-back-to-sir-amik-varze.player: Ok! I'll get on to sabotaging that potion.

sabotaging-the-potion-interrupting-the-b.speaker: Fortress Guard
sabotaging-the-potion-interrupting-the-b.text: I wouldn't go in there if I were you. Those Black Knights are in an important meeting. They said they'd kill anyone who went in there!

steps.speaker: Fortress Guard
steps.text: Wise move.

options.text: I don't care. I'm going in anyway.

steps.player: I don't care. I'm going in anyway.

sabotaging-the-potion-using-any-item-on-.player: Why exactly would I want to do that?

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-draynor-ca.text: This is the wrong sort of cabbage!

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-draynor-ca.player: I'm not supposed to be HELPING the witch you know...

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.text: The player throws the cabbage through the hole

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.speaker: Witch
sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.text: Where has Greldo got to with that magic cabbage!

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.speaker: Witch
sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.text: Hopefully Greldo with the cabbage... yes, look here it co....NOOOOOoooo!
The cabbage falls through the hole in the ceiling and lands in the potion, destroying it.

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.speaker: Black Knight Captain
sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.text: Oh boy, this doesn't look good!

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.speaker: Black Cat
sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.text: Meow!No special dialogue with catspeak amulet equipped

sabotaging-the-potion-using-a-normal-cab.player: Looks like my work here is done. Seems like that's successfully sabotaged their little secret weapon plan.

sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.speaker: Witch
sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.text: It's RUINED! All that work, FIVE years down the drain, who was it! I'll find them and when I do....

sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.speaker: Black Knight Captain
sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.text: Erm.. maybe we can save some of it?

sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.speaker: Witch
sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.text: SAVE some of it? Are you mad!? That cabbage was a normal cabbage, it spoilt the whole thing and now I have to start all over again!

sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.speaker: Black Knight Captain
sabotaging-the-potion-listen-at-grill-af.text: No need to... get upset... you're scar ing the cat.

returning-to-sir-amik-varze.player: I have ruined the Black Knights' invincibility potion. That should put a stop to your problem and an end to their little schemes.

returning-to-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
returning-to-sir-amik-varze.text: Yes, we have just received a message from the Black Knights saying they withdraw their demands, which would seem to confirm your story.

returning-to-sir-amik-varze.player: Now I believe there was some talk of a cash reward...

returning-to-sir-amik-varze.speaker: Sir Amik Varze
returning-to-sir-amik-varze.text: Absolutely right. Please accept this reward.
